note: BORDERLINE. The AR page has no CO-style wording (no 'sumar el módulo Tu Delivery a tu plan'); its FAQ asks only for 'una cuenta activa en Fudo', the heading says 'Activá Tu Delivery en minutos y sin costo adicional' and the benefits 'Sin abono mensual ni permanencia'; also 'Activá tu cuenta gratis y en 15 minutos ya estás operando.' (free trial). But /es-ar/precios/ lists no free plan (only Plan Inicial $23.900 /mes, Avanzado $46.500 /mes, Pro $93.500 /mes, all 'Precio final'; Inicial 'Sin impuestos nacionales: $19.752'), says 'El único costo de Fudo es el abono mensual.' and offers only a free trial, so an 'active account' after the trial probably means a paid plan — not stated in words. base_plan filled for reference only (the cheapest plan, in case 'cuenta activa' is read as a paid plan). Fee cap: '1,9% + IVA de tasa de servicio por cada venta, con un tope de $99.000 + IVA por mes' — 'El tope aplica solo si activás Fudo Pagos como procesador de pago online.' Billing toggle 'Mensual / Semestral −10% / Anual −15%'; the headline prices are not labelled with a period. The 'Delivery Apps +$19.500' module on /precios is the aggregator integration, not Tu Delivery.
